name: shadow-project
purpose: Create or refresh an interface-only shadow for the bound project, including architecture links and knowledge, without changing source or requiring Git.
pre_prompt: The orchestrator binds the actual project in session launch.json. No model-supplied project path is accepted. Native AST parsing creates prototypes; no project code is executed. Output lives in owned skill artifacts, outside source.
post_prompt: Use architecture.md and INDEX.txt to select relevant prototypes. This is a navigation map, not proof of behavior. Parse errors and missing descriptions remain explicit. Never upload the source implementation as a planning substitute.
